findings.statement: Long inputs at modest cost: the authors report pretraining on inputs up to 200 kb on one 32 GB V100, and pretraining took 60 hours on four RTX 3090 GPUs.
findings.source_says: "we evaluated the model's time and space complexity during long-sequence pretraining ... On a single NVIDIA Tesla V100 with 32GB memory, OmniReg-GPT architecture could accommodate DNA sequence inputs up to 200 kb"; the model itself was pretrained "using 20 kb sequence windows".
findings.fix: Long inputs at modest cost: in a memory test the authors report the architecture could fit inputs up to 200 kb on one 32 GB V100, although the released model was pretrained on 20 kb windows. Pretraining took 60 hours on four RTX 3090 GPUs.

summary: Reliable overall. One strength overstates the 200 kb result as actual pretraining when the paper reports it as a memory capacity test; everything else matches the README, Zenodo record, licence and paper.
